answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose an MSP model for personalized response generation ... The target is to generate a personalized response r_i for the user u_i to reply a new query q.

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate all methods by several metrics with respect to different aspects. (1) BLEU-1/2 and ROUGE-L ... (2) Distinct-1/2 ... (3) The embedding-based metrics ... (4) Persona-F1 ... Persona Coverage ...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation of all methods. Concretely, we sample 100 (query, response, user dialogue history) triplets and hire three well-educated annotators to score the responses generated by different models. Three aspects, i.e., readability, informativeness, and personalization, are considered.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators score each response on readability (scale 1-5), informativeness (scale 1-5), and personalization (scale 0-1).
